title: CE31003: Soil Mechanics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Formation of soils, index properties and classification of soils,
Soil compaction, Proctor and modified compaction, field control of compaction,
Effective stress, soil-water-system - surface tension and capillarity, Darcy s
law, Permeability of soils, methods of determining coefficient of permeability,
Seepage analysis, flow nets, piping, quick sand condition, Compressibility and
consolidation of soils, Normally and over consolidated soil, determination of
over consolidation pressure, time rate of consolidation, determination of
coefficient of consolidation, Shear strength of soils, direct shear and triaxial test, MohrâCoulomb strength criterion, drained, consolidated undrained
and drained test, pore pressures, Skempton s pore pressure coefficients,
stability of slopes, factor of safety, limit equilibrium methods, ordinary
method of slices and Bishop s modified method of slices, earth pressure
theories, smooth and rough walls, inclined backfill, depth of tension crack.
